source_name: President of North Macedonia pretsedatel.mk /en English tree (Wayback/CDX)
leaders_covered: Gjorge Ivanov; Stevo Pendarovski; Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 2,056 captures of pretsedatel.mk/en (3,021 raw before filtering), spanning 2010-2026. ALL THREE FIELDS GREEN on every sample: TITLE(h1.entry-title / <title> on the old Joomla generation), TEXT(.et_pb_post_content / .entry-content / #colmain) 262-3,827 chars, DATE(span.published / span.createdate) 2018-02-16 .. 2026-03-13. GENUINE English (verified on samples, not an untranslated /en/ mirror). ENGLISH SIBLING of the live Macedonian mkd_pretsedatel.yml, which deliberately harvests only the two MACEDONIAN WP categories (123 items) and skips the English translations - so overlap is small and this lands English in the English column with NO machine translation. THREE archived layouts handled: 2019-era Divi post (.entry-content), 2022+ Divi theme-builder (.et_pb_post_content; .entry-content absent), and the older Joomla /en/media-centre/(news|speeches|press-releases)/<id>.html. DATE TRAP documented: span.published matches SIX times on the theme-builder layout (article + five sidebar 'recent posts'), but the article's own date comes first in document order and parse_date's search_dates fallback picks it - verified. COMPOSITION CAVEAT: the /en/ feed is news-heavy (many sampled items are short third-person notices of 262-2,500 chars); genuine addresses are present but the cleaner's document_type gate will reject a large share, so treat the 2,056 as an upper bound on rows, not on speeches. NO speaker_default (three presidents). FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
